source_snapshot.procedure: Open BMC-Web Hardware Status / Inventory and LEDs, but the prescribed observation is `Chassis` information; the boilerplate also asks to clear logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All information should match SPEC definition.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; queries a DIMM/Memory subset (SocketLocator, PartNumber, CapacityMiB), assumes a non-authoritative `.Dimms` projection and omits the source's Chassis branch.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; preserves the DIMM-versus-Chassis conflict and calls for complete slot/member/spec evidence after owner scope selection.

old_problem: The row's named object is DIMM, but the literal BMC-Web Procedure asks for Chassis. Its generic `all information` criterion does not determine whether the target is physical memory population/slot mapping or chassis members/attributes. The DeepSeek Memory request favors DIMM without authority and samples only three values. The two domains have incompatible membership and comparison models; the exact next Power-supplies/Fans case is an independent source identity, not a repair for this one.
disposition_reason: Retain Engineering Decision Pending and source conflict while keeping REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION rather than BLOCKED. Both possible observations are safely understandable as read-only once the owner declares the intended domain, provides the right collection/UI mapping and signs its expected matrix. No existing decision identifies this row's `Chassis` word as an approved copy correction; selecting DIMM because it is more plausible would silently alter the source method, while checking only Chassis would abandon the title/DeepSeek memory coverage. The overlay preserves conditional DIMM and Chassis paths, prevents either from becoming a result until the owner selects or splits them, and does not manufacture a threshold or inventory baseline.
decision_basis: The original XLSX Functionality row 1623, matching same-row DeepSeek/test-json data, exact V2 and historical V3.1 records, pending/conflict analyses and exact identity history were reread. The actual next formal queue identity was reconstructed from the immutable queue and directly opened in XLSX as row 1625 / Wistron-BMC-00896-V002 / f9f79a478ff7d28b.

DIMM inventory entails a population of physical slots and memory members; a valid capacity, part number and locator can still be wrong for socket/channel/slot, duplicated, absent, disabled, spare, mirrored, ghosted or stale. Chassis inventory has a different collection, relationship graph and fields and cannot establish memory population correctness.

The DeepSeek three-value query neither proves the full DIMM collection/member resource layout nor handles special states, firmware locator mapping or complete expected attributes. The query's TLS bypass and command-line credential pattern are unacceptable evidence handling regardless of branch selection.

A read-only BMC UI/API collection is technically feasible without changing memory configuration, BIOS state, host power or workload. The missing decision is the source-controlled inspection scope and its authoritative matrix, not a required destructive command or unknowable recovery action.

If DIMM is selected, complete population must relate the approved physical slot/locator to BMC memory member and independent BIOS/OS evidence with documented special-state rules. If Chassis is selected, it needs its own complete member/role/field matrix; the memory data cannot be silently repurposed.

ED-20 keeps the source-required BMC-Web UI/screenshots as genuine visual evidence—an API can corroborate, never replace, that observation. ED-12 does not apply because no source-key-approved copy-error ruling exists. ED-24 requires the conflict to remain traceable in an overlay.

ED-02/ED-21 prevent this DIMM case from merging with neighboring inventory conflicts; ED-03/ED-13 allow a documented protected BMC read draft but not guessed resource semantics; ED-26 forbids automatic retry; ED-33/ED-35/ED-36/ED-38 preserve Master/coverage and prohibit a static or API-only DUT verdict.

test_case.test_name: Inventory and LEDs - DIMM — unresolved memory/chassis scope with safe read-only branches
test_case.purpose: Maintain both literal obligations in row 1623 until the owner determines whether the test validates DIMM inventory, Chassis inventory, or two independently accepted observations. The review preserves the original evidence boundary without changing memory, chassis or power state.
required_package: Owner ruling for DIMM, Chassis or explicitly separate checkpoints; recorded disposition of the other literal wording while Master remains unchanged
Verified same-SUT/BMC identity, BMC firmware/UI version, protected UI/API access, validated TLS and evidence retention that excludes credential disclosure

For DIMM: signed physical slot/socket/channel/DIMM/member matrix; manufacturer, serial/part, capacity, type, speed, rank, health and population expectations; firmware locator/BMC member/BIOS/OS correlation; rules for empty, disabled, spare, mirrored, virtual and stale entries
For Chassis: approved collection/member/role/physical-location and required-field matrix, vendor schema/UI mapping and treatment of absent/degraded/stale chassis objects
Complete selected-domain BMC-Web screenshots/photos, full collection and every member capture, normalized comparison report, no-mutation audit and engineer verdict process
test_case.test_command: NOT STARTED — no branch is authorized as the testcase result before scope selection. Following an owner DIMM decision, use a protected documented interface to capture the full BMC memory collection and every advertised member, plus mandatory BMC-Web visual evidence; correlate each approved slot/locator with BIOS/OS evidence and compare all signed fields/special states. Following a Chassis decision, capture the selected full chassis collection/UI and compare its separately signed matrix. In either branch report missing, unexpected, duplicate, stale, malformed or mismatched members, retain raw/normalized evidence and review relevant logs without clearing them. Do not use `curl -k`, inline credentials, a fixed `.Dimms` projection, a three-field filter or an API-only substitute for the WebUI requirement.
test_case.expected_result: Before a ruling, the only expected result is an owner-selected scope and its complete expected inventory matrix. A DIMM branch may only be assessed against a complete slot/population/member and field contract; a Chassis branch may only be assessed against its own member/role/field contract. If the owner preserves both, each outcome is separate and neither makes the other PASS. No DUT result is asserted by this review.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: The case remains Engineering Decision Pending until the selection and matching expected matrix exist. Under a future DIMM contract, PASS evidence needs a complete one-to-one approved physical-slot/firmware-locator/BMC-member mapping, field-level comparison and supported explanation for every special state; capacity total or three fields alone is insufficient. Under a future Chassis contract, PASS needs the complete chosen chassis-member comparison. Missing, extra, wrong-slot, duplicate, disabled/stale/ghost or unexplained mismatched data is escalated to the engineer; an HTTP success, adjacent case result or generic `matches SPEC` statement is not PASS. The engineer owns final PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Do not decide that `Chassis` is a typo or make the DIMM URI authoritative simply because Items and DeepSeek use memory language.
Do not merge Chassis and DIMM payloads to create an undefined composite acceptance result, or borrow fields/matrix from neighboring inventory rows.
Keep all potential work observational: never alter DIMM population/configuration, memory RAS policy, BIOS/UEFI setup, power state, cooling or chassis controls, and do not run memory stress.
Do not clear SEL, dmesg, syslog or BMC audit records; preserve existing error/presence evidence and evaluate only the authorized time-correlated observations.
Reject cross-SUT, cached, partial or unverified member data. Protect credentials/TLS and redact identifiers as required by evidence policy.
BMC-Web screenshots/photos remain required source evidence. API/Redfish output is auxiliary and does not prove the visual interface by itself.
No automatic repeat, no source edit and no DUT verdict. Stop interpretation when selected-domain completeness or mapping cannot be demonstrated.
expected_evidence: Source Key/variant/hash; both literal source nouns; DeepSeek/V2/history comparison and the signed scope-disposition overlay
Same-SUT/BMC/UI identity, BMC firmware/UI version, selected schema/matrix and protected timestamped BMC-Web screenshots/photos
For DIMM: raw complete memory collection/members, physical slot/locator plus BIOS/OS correlation, all field/special-state results and a normalized mapping/mismatch ledger
For Chassis: complete approved chassis collection/members, required role/location attributes and independent matrix comparison
No-mutation/session evidence, retained relevant logs/audit entries and an engineer-owned disposition; current proof that no DUT action or verdict occurred
test_case.recovery: No state-changing test activity is authorized. On unresolved scope, wrong-target collection or incomplete mapping, stop comparison, preserve raw UI/API captures and BMC/host identity evidence, close the protected session and verify no memory/BIOS/chassis/power control changed. Do not clear logs, reboot, reseat DIMMs, modify BIOS or repeat queries to force a clean result. Any later mutating proposal requires its own safety/recovery review.

source_conflict.reason: The requested Item/AI domain is DIMM/Memory but the sole procedural observation is Chassis. They are different inventory graphs and neither branch receives unapproved precedence.

blocked.reason: A safe non-mutating collection and recovery boundary is clear for either selected scope. The remaining need is an owner-provided inspection domain and authoritative expected matrix, so execution readiness is pending rather than an irreducible semantic-operation block.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: DIMM-versus-Chassis ruling or separate checkpoints; selected BMC-Web/API resource/schema; same-SUT mapping; complete DIMM slot/population/special-state matrix or complete Chassis matrix; UI proof, protected access/evidence handling and engineer disposition workflow.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; NO BMC/WEBUI/API DATA INTERPRETED AS DUT EVIDENCE, NO DIMM/BIOS/MEMORY/CHASSIS/POWER/LOG/DUT ACTION AUTHORIZED OR EXECUTED BEFORE SCOPE RULING

project_authority: The BMC/platform owner chooses the scope and its collection/UI semantics; the memory owner provides the DIMM population/slot matrix if applicable; the chassis owner provides the Chassis matrix if applicable; an operator supplies visual evidence; the engineer decides verdict. They cannot edit Master, infer a correction from a nearby row, waive the visual requirement or use a dimensionally incomplete API sample as a full inventory result.
